subject: OrionPay sudden throughput & error surge — RCA, exec stewardship, and closure
messages:
From: Dana Owens <dana.owens@orionpay.com>

Cc: sre@orionpay.com
Date: 2026-11-24T10:12:00Z
Subject: Spike in latency & 5xx errors (Nov 24 09:58–10:10 PT) — urgent

Hi Sergio / Laura,

We observed a sharp spike in tail latency and an accompanying ~4% 5xx error rate between 09:58 and 10:10 PT this morning. Our tokenized payment flow saw timeouts on the /infer endpoint and a small but visible drop in success rate. Attached are our SRE snippets and the initial traces.

This impacted a handful of high-value transactions and triggered downstream retries. Can Redwood confirm you've got a bridge and timeline? Our team is ready to jump in. We need an ETA for a root cause summary and a mitigation plan (including whether you plan to shift us to dedicated capacity or a temporary routing change).

Dana Owens
Head of Platform Reliability, OrionPay
Dana.Owens@orionpay.com
Attachments: orion-sre-snippets.txt
From: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-24T10:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in latency & 5xx errors (Nov 24 09:58–10:10 PT) — urgent

Dana — thanks for the heads up and the snippets.

We spun up an immediate bridge with Product/Infra/Eng. Laura (CS) and Kimberly (SRE lead) are on the call. Initial telemetry shows elevated KV cache churn in the LRU of our prefix cache and concurrent request storms on a small subset of shards. No config rollout on our side in that window.

Action for now:
- Bridge active, debugging (Sergio / Kimberly)
- Short-term mitigation: reduce batch window for OrionPay routes to lower concurrency (in flight) — rolling starting in 5m
- We'll draft an exec-level brief + RCA by EOD PT and share an action tracker.

I'll keep you updated in this thread.

— Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Account Lead, Priority Customers — Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-24T11:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Spike in latency & 5xx errors — preliminary findings

Quick triage notes (preliminary):
- Symptom: transient surge of simultaneous requests that drained a hot subset of KV caches; on our infra this caused increased cache-repopulation latency and elevated disk IO on shard-7 for ~8m.
- Likely contributors: simultaneous publish from a customer-side scheduler + a backend retry storm caused by a client timeout threshold.
- Short-term mitigation applied: tightened per-route batch sizing (reduced max batch by 40%), enabled additional async prefetch on the KV path for the affected prefix, and throttled a small percentage of in-flight requests for 10 minutes.
- Evidence: attached kv-cache-heatmap.png and timeline-events.csv (events correlate with customer traces).

Proposed post-incident actions (will be included in RCA):
1) Introduce a soft concurrency cap per-customer route that isolates storms (owner: Karthik, ETA: 2 days)
2) Improve KV cache eviction policy to avoid cascade repopulation (owner: Infra Core, ETA: 3 weeks)
3) Add a per-route circuit-breaker + metrics alerting for cache-regeneration pressure (owner: Observability, ETA: 1 week)

I'll prepare a formal RCA doc and stitch the event timeline.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
Attachments: kv-cache-heatmap.png, timeline-events.csv

Subject: OrionPay — RCA draft + action tracker (v0.1)

Dana — attaching the first RCA draft and a concise action tracker. Key points:
- Impact window: 2026-11-24T09:58–10:10 PT; ~1.2k requests affected, ~27 failed transactions that triggered retries.
- Root cause (short): cache regeneration pressure caused by synchronized retry pattern plus a temporary hotspot on shard-7.
- Immediate mitigation executed: per-route batch reduction + temporary throttling; success rate returned to baseline in ~12m.

Action tracker (abbreviated):
- Karthik / Infra: implement soft per-route concurrency cap (ETA: 48h)
- Infra Core: eviction strategy overhaul (ETA: 3w)
- Observability: circuit-breaker + alerting (ETA: 7d)
- CS (Laura): customer messaging + credit recommendation (ETA: EOD tomorrow)
- Accounts (Sergio): business remediation proposal (discount / one-time credit) (ETA: 24h)

Please review the attached RCA-draft-v0.1 and let me know any edits.

Attachments: orionpay-rca-draft-v1.pdf

Dana / Team —

Thanks for the patience while we finalized the RCA and action commitments.

Summary:
- Final RCA attached (orionpay-rca-final.pdf). Root cause confirmed: combined client retry pattern and unguarded cache repopulation on a single shard leading to temporary IO pressure and higher tail latency.
- Completed near-term items: reduced batch window (applied), temporary throttling (applied), and dedicated monitoring rule to detect cache-regeneration pressure.
- Committed longer-term items (owners & delivery windows included in the attached tracker).
- Business remediation: Sergio will propose a one-time service credit for impacted transactions and a discounted trial of burst capacity; proposal expected within 24h.

Next steps:
1) Customer acceptance: Dana, please confirm whether the RCA and proposed remediation meet OrionPay's needs and whether you want temporary dedicated capacity.
2) Internal follow-through: Karthik/Infra to start soft concurrency cap work tomorrow; weekly check-ins to track progress until delivery.

We consider the incident operationally closed from a mitigation standpoint; the action tracker will remain open until all items are completed.

Best —
Laura Bennett
Customer Success Director, Redwood Inference
